method: Public HTTPS GET only. Decoded document MDContent from official SSR router data where available. No authenticated account access, model inference, billing changes or resource activation. account_evidence: User reports Free Tokens Only mode explicitly On. Screenshot quota/model observations are historical; no live balance or billing query.
limitations: Some URLs returned a JavaScript shell or no published body; official lowercase-library aliases recovered key terms.
Public-browser rendering attempts encountered certificate trust errors; TLS verification was not disabled. Public HTTPS retrievals succeeded with the normal verified HTTP client.
Private account eligibility, model inference behavior, quality and existing chargeable resources were not tested.
